name: Worgen in the Woods
summary: Calor sends you into southern Duskwood against the Nightbane pack. Their dens and mines bring the worgen threat close to Darkshire.

sections.title: A Feral Foothold
sections.body: South of Darkshire, Nightbane worgen fortify caves and abandoned mine shafts as camps. Calor watches their bonfires and fears what their growing hold means for the town. Among the pack, the Vile Fangs and Tainted Ones are its fiercest breeds. Their savagery and stubbornness threaten Darkshire’s perimeter.

sections.title: Calor's Endorsement
sections.body: Calor watches Darkshire’s front line and knows how dangerous the worgen are. Defeating the Vile Fangs and Tainted Ones tests any hero. Those who defeat them earn his respect and a personal recommendation to Master Carevin, who coordinates the wider fight against the worgen.

faq.q: Where are the Vile Fangs and Tainted Ones located?
faq.answer: The Vile Fangs and Tainted Ones gather around caves and the mine in southern Duskwood, often near bonfires.

aliases: who gives worgen in the woods 3
faq.answer: Calor lives in Darkshire and watches the worgen threat in the woods. He enlists capable adventurers to halt their advance.
Master Carevin is Jonathan Carevin of Darkshire. His family fights the region’s evils, and he coordinates efforts to eradicate the nearby worgen.

faq.q: Why do the worgen have bonfires?
faq.answer: The Nightbane worgen gather in organized camps, use fire, and hold fortified positions such as mines. Their camps reveal an unsettling intelligence beneath their monstrous, wolf-like appearance.

faq.q: What happens after completing this hunt?
aliases: next quest after worgen in the woods 3
worgen in the woods follow up
faq.answer: Impressing Calor earns you a letter of recommendation to Master Carevin. Then you can help him in the next phase of the hunt.

faq.q: Why is Darkshire so concerned about these specific worgen?
faq.answer: The Vile Fangs and Tainted Ones are among the pack’s most lethal and aggressive members. If left unchecked near the southern mines, they could overrun the surrounding roads.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you help protect Darkshire’s supply lines and Duskwood’s remaining homesteads by clearing the southern caves.
As a hunter, you face unusual prey in the cunning Nightbane pack. Stay vigilant near their dark dens.
